verdict.wrong_value: hyp2f1(1.3, -0.2, 0.3, -2.1) returned NaN instead of 1.8202169687521206; gamma pole behavior also wrong (gamma(-0.0) etc.)
verdict.rationale: The fix addresses a wrong computed value: after a gamma pole-behavior change, cephes hyp2f1 divides by gamma values and returned NaN for valid inputs. The PR replaces gamma with rgamma in denominators to restore the correct finite result (1.8202169687521206), and corrects gamma at poles. This is a numerical accuracy/special-value defect, not an API or message change.
